The gradle-wrapper.jar binary and gradlew/gradlew.bat scripts are not
committed to this repo (the jar is a binary file, generated boilerplate).

GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/build.yml, build-android job) does not
need this file: it generates a fresh wrapper itself on every run via
`gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.7`, using the Gradle binary installed
by gradle/actions/setup-gradle. That is the supported, verified build path.

For local development, generate the wrapper once yourself:
    cd android/ChronixAgent
    gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.7

Or simply open android/ChronixAgent/ in Android Studio, which will
offer to sync and regenerate the wrapper automatically.
